$comment: Two maps. "overrides": per-word text sent to the voice instead of the default "<word>." -- for words a bare render mispronounces (the solar-storybook Sun /su:n/ lesson); keyed by the lowercased word, used by render-words.py for the tap-a-word clips. "narration": whole-word, case-sensitive substitutions applied by render-pages.py ONLY to the text SENT to the TTS for page narration (owner 2026-10-14: the displayed word Io is narrated "Eye-oh", Thai ไอโอ, not "ee-oh"). The displayed page text, timing words and word highlighting never change: the returned character alignment is mapped back onto the displayed text, and provenance records the substitution as "sent_text". Replacements are not re-substituted. Both maps stay empty until a clip fails listening QA.
